# Finanzr 0.1.0-alpha.1

First public alpha of Finanzr, a self-hosted dashboard for savings, investments
and net worth.

Highlights include workspace-scoped cookie/CSRF authentication; owner, editor
and viewer roles; savings, funds, stocks/ETFs, crypto, real-estate and portfolio
views; deterministic synthetic importer fixtures; and encrypted logical backup
and restore commands.

Install from this release's source archive or check out tag
`v0.1.0-alpha.1`, then follow the [README](https://github.com/peroanjo/finanzr/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/README.md#quick-start). Existing
installations should read the [update and rollback guidance](https://github.com/peroanjo/finanzr/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/README.md#self-hosting)
and create a verified encrypted backup before applying migrations. Restoration
steps are in [the security operations guide](https://github.com/peroanjo/finanzr/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/docs/security.md#operations).

This is source-only alpha software. Versioned container images are not yet
published. Operators provide HTTPS/ingress, secrets, monitoring and off-host
backup storage. Market data may be delayed or unavailable, and supported import
formats are intentionally limited. Verify all financial and tax figures against
primary records. See the [full changelog](https://github.com/peroanjo/finanzr/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/CHANGELOG.md#010-alpha1---2026-09-08).

Dependency updates in open pull requests #53 and #56 were intentionally deferred
because their candidate checks were failing when this release was prepared.
